name: promptbutton
description: One press: reads the conversation, asks what the model still needs, rewrites your prompt.

scripts.eval: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx eval/run.mts && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx eval/judge.mts
scripts.desktop:build: npm run desktop:helper && esbuild desktop/main.ts desktop/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --outdir=desktop/dist --out-extension:.js=.cjs --packages=external --sourcemap && vite build --config desktop/vite.renderer.config.ts
scripts.desktop: npm run desktop:build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron .
scripts.desktop:helper: mkdir -p desktop/bin && xcrun swiftc -O -o desktop/bin/axhelper desktop/native/axhelper.swift && xcrun swiftc -O -o desktop/bin/dictate desktop/native/dictate.swift -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker desktop/native/dictate-Info.plist
